episodeTitle.zh: 变得更具战略眼光、应对难相处的同事、创始人模式等挑战 | 安妮卡·古普塔

guestBioOfficial.en: Anneka Gupta is the Chief Product Officer at Rubrik, a leading B2B cybersecurity company. She previously spent 11 years at LiveRamp, where she was the President and Head of Product and Platforms leading product development and go-to-market operations and strategy. Anneka also sits on the board of directors for Tinuiti and teaches product management at Stanford University. In our conversation, we discuss: • Navigating “founder mode” dynamics in organizations

title.en: Becoming more strategic, navigating difficult colleagues, founder mode, more | Anneka Gupta
title.zh: 变得更具战略眼光、应对难相处的同事、创始人模式等挑战 | 安妮卡·古普塔

summary.en: Anneka reframes what it means to be “strategic”: being able to articulate a compelling why and acting as a change agent for long-term interests even when it's hard. She shares advice on navigating difficult personalities, giving and receiving hard feedback, and bringing humor and gratitude to every situation. The conversation also covers managing your energy versus your time, tactical ways to become more strategic, and how to break into product management.
summary.zh: Anneka 重新定义了“有策略”的含义：能清晰阐述有说服力的“为什么”，并即便艰难也充当推动长期利益的变革者。她分享了应对难缠性格、给予和接受尖锐反馈，以及把幽默与感恩带入每个场景的建议。对话还涵盖管理精力而非时间、变得更有策略的实操方法，以及如何进入产品经理行业。
